source: Meta Ad Library (India, active ads) + the company's own live website

ads.destination: Instagram (instagram.com/ray_on_solar_systems_) with an fb.me 'Get Quote' button
ads.text: Reduce Your Electricity Bills with Solar - 3kW Solar Power System Offer. Get your 3kW solar system at a special price with subsidy and long-term warranty support. (Ad destination links to the company's Instagram profile; the Get Quote button goes to a generic fb.me link.)

ad_library.summary: Ray On Solar Systems is running 1 live ad on Meta (Library ID 1107666674962232, started 13 October 2026) offering a 3kW solar system at a special price with subsidy - and the ad sends the click to Instagram, not to the company's website. The company is based in Visakhapatnam and is advertising into Telangana.

funnel.destination: instagram.com/ray_on_solar_systems_ (ad creative link) and fb.me ('Get Quote')
funnel.meaning: A social profile is not a funnel. There is no lead capture, no quote form and nothing to retarget - and the site's own free-quote form sits unused while the ad pays for clicks.

findings: The live 3kW-offer ad (Library ID 1107666674962232, started 13 October 2026) sends Telugu solar buyers to an Instagram profile - not to rayonsolarsystems.in. A profile has no lead capture, no phone form and nothing to retarget.
The ad's 'Get Quote' button goes to a generic fb.me link - the click never lands on a page that takes a name, a phone number or a bill amount.

The site itself is a clean WordPress build with a free-quote form, on-grid/off-grid rooftop systems, PM Surya Ghar subsidy assistance and a real-time monitoring section - none of it is in the paid path.
Visakhapatnam-based (Ravi Nagar, Naidu Thota, 530029) and advertising into Telangana - no Telangana service-area proof for the buyer the ad is aimed at.
One live ad is the entire paid presence - no second creative, no retargeting, nothing to A/B test.
next_steps: Point the ad at the site's own quote page
The site already has a free-quote form and the PM Surya Ghar subsidy section - sending the 3kW-offer click there instead of Instagram turns the spend into measurable leads.
Or build a dedicated 3kW offer page
A landing page carrying the ad's exact offer - special 3kW price, subsidy, long-term warranty - with name, phone and locality captured before any chat.
A service-area statement and named local installs turn a Visakhapatnam advertiser into a local option for the Telugu buyer.
One ad cannot tell you which message works - a subsidy-focused and an EMI-focused version against each other would.
contact_facts: Ray On Solar Systems - claims 5+ years of technical experience

controls.name: Meta Pixel installed
controls.evidence: Landing page was not source-checked for this report; needs a page-source pull or account access.

controls.name: UTM parameters on ad destinations
controls.evidence: Live ads click to a Facebook lead form (fb.me) - traffic never reaches a page you own, so no URL can carry UTMs and click data stays inside Meta.

controls.name: Domain verification
controls.evidence: Business Manager domain verification cannot be observed from public ad data; needs account access.

controls.name: Creative format diversity
controls.evidence: Ad-card formats were not captured for these ads.

controls.name: Creative concept coverage
controls.evidence: Only 2 offer angle in live copy (government subsidy, warranty) - every ad says the same thing.

controls.name: Social proof utilization
controls.evidence: No social proof (customer counts, reviews, testimonials) in the live ad copy.

controls.name: Video aspect ratios
controls.evidence: Creative files cannot be downloaded from the Ad Library; needs account access or the raw creatives.

controls.name: UGC / social-native content
controls.evidence: Content style cannot be verified from ad cards alone.

controls.name: CTR benchmark
controls.evidence: No spend or impression data is public for this advertiser; the catalog forbids benchmark guessing.

controls.name: Creative freshness
controls.evidence: Live creatives include recent launches (newest started Oct 13, 2026) - the account is not running one stale ad forever.

controls.name: Campaign fragmentation
controls.evidence: A single live ad - no internal comparison, no safety net if it fatigues.

controls.name: Campaign objective alignment
controls.evidence: Ad CTA and destination agree on one job: Instagram + generic fb.me link.

controls.name: Creative fatigue detection
controls.evidence: Frequency and performance decay need account metrics.

ads_audit.methodology: Control review follows the claude-ads Meta Ads audit catalog (github.com/vamsy16/claude-ads, ads/references/meta-audit.md). Each control is graded only where public evidence establishes it - Ad Library ad data and the lead's own landing page. Controls that require Ads Manager access (bidding, budgets, audiences, learning phase, EMQ, CAPI status) are marked unknown on purpose: they cannot be verified from outside the account and are never guessed.
ads_audit.account_only: M02 Conversions API, M03 event deduplication, M04 Event Match Quality, M06 aggregated measurement, M07 standard vs custom events, M08 CAPI Gateway, M09/M-AT1 attribution windows, M10 data freshness, M13/M14 learning phase, M15/M16 campaign & ad-set structure, M17 budget distribution, M36 bid strategy, M37 frequency caps, M38 breakdown reporting, M40 A/B testing, M19-M24 audiences & first-party data
